title: Vote First, Judge on Ties: Cost-Aware Answer Selection for Language-Model Systems (OR-Select)
description: OR-Select v1.3.0: code, public stored runs, generated tables, the revised manuscript and online supplement, and the submission package for Vote First, Judge on Ties: Cost-Aware Answer Selection for Language-Model Systems. New since v1.1.0: the Bayes-optimal posterior-odds gate with exact sequential judging, the headroom analysis, the vote-first (judge on ties) optimality result, the difficulty-mixture threshold, the collision model with margin-gated judging, universal self-consistency on all stored pools with the free judge, and pairwise judging and universal self-consistency with two paid small judges (Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT Luna) with partial coverage. Stored runs for the new analyses are in outputs/usc_baseline.json and outputs/strong_judge_*.json. GPQA Diamond files embed password-gated question text and are not included. This release does not overwrite earlier archives.
